newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPS TO GRASP 136.19 FOOTHOLD FOR GAINS.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPS TO GRASP 136.19 FOOTHOLD FOR GAINS.

text.p: September BTP futures on LIFFE will push yet higher after a strong start, with 136.19 as a spur for further gains, technical analysts said on Tuesday.
"I'm glad BTPs have gone higher -- I was expecting them to do that," said Nicholas Rose, technical analyst at 4CAST in London.
"I would be bullish for the contract when it reaches 136.19, Thursday's high," he added.
September BTPs were trading at 136.03 at 0720 GMT, up 49 basis points on the day. The contract reached a session high of 136.10 earlier.
Elizabeth Miller, technical analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London, also found resistance at 136.19, and then at 136.43. "That is a retracement from the upside," she said.
The 136.43 level is a 50 percent retracement on 30 minute charts from the recent move down from the July 30 high of 138.13, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said.
"That is a 1.618 projection of the recent setback."
Daily charts show BTPs dropped from a high of 136.19 on Thursday to a low of 134.97 on Friday, before pulling back.
"BTPs can move swiftly ahead," Rose said.
Miller placed further resistance at 137.33, and support from 135.85 to 135.00.
"On the downside, 135.00 is a key retracement from the gains from April 1. Once we break that, we can go to 134.68, 133.77 and 133.25, downside retracements on the weekly charts," she said.
Daily charts show September BTPs reached a low of 123.80 on April 1, and a high of 138.44 on July 23.
Rose found near-term support at 135.80, close to Monday's high of 135.85, with further support at 135.62.
